sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We appreciate the cost context and our long relationship, and understand that larger price steps need committee approval. The binding volume figure follows; this is our full demand for the part over the term, placed with you, and our forecast is rising, giving us a basis to discuss improved terms alongside the planning security of a long contract. Could the owner walk us through the calculation, as previously offered, so we can explore what flexibility may be possible?

We confirm a binding volume of 23700 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014292-10).
In our call of 2026-09-04 (doc:20260904-70740-M1) you offered to walk us through your calculation; we would welcome that now.
Our forecast for this part is up 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.77 per unit, fixed price, payment 45 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 23700 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Thank you for confirming the annual volume of 23,700 units; we are available to schedule a meeting to review our cost calculation. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

We can accommodate the 36-month contract and 45-day payment terms, but a fixed price over three years is not feasible, requiring the application of the AS-14404 index. In recognition of your volume commitment and these updated terms, we propose a revised price of €5.60 per unit.

Our updated offer is a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.60 per unit. This option has a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
